method_c2: finite-grid posterior probability of error > 5 mm for the shared GLS point estimate
method_d: 0.75 C2 + 0.25 times equal-weight mixture of local nuisance-adjusted information deficit and global near-collision score
probability_calibration: development-only monotone logistic fit; assess Brier/reliability on independent test
acceptance_thresholds: calibration-only raw scores at nominal 80 percent coverage
primary_matched_test_coverage: exactly 80 percent test scores ranked retrospectively without labels; does not represent a calibrated deployment threshold
decision_rule: To count as supportive exploratory evidence: numerical audit passes, >=30 independent-test error events, C2 risk - D risk >=0.02, paired 95% whole-sequence bootstrap lower bound >0. No automatic discovery claim.
